Private villa design — Jeddah

Villa design in Jeddah, inside and out

If the family living room opens onto a courtyard, where will you sit, and what can visitors see from the entrance? Work directly with Wael Bousmael to plan the rooms, windows and facade together, starting with your plot in Jeddah and the way your family lives.

Request a free call WhatsApp

Family and guest entrances

On the plan, we trace a guest’s route to the majlis and bathroom alongside the family’s routes between the kitchen, living rooms and courtyard. You can then decide where a separate entrance matters and which rooms should open into each other.

How the interior plan shapes the facade

We start each window from inside the room. What will you see from the sofa, and what can someone see from the street? In the Montashiri Villa design in Obhur, the double-height living room looks through broad glazing into a planted courtyard. Facing the street, stone walls and timber screens limit views into the house.

See the facade and kitchen at Montashiri Villa

What the first concept helps you decide

We review room positions, window orientation and how you reach the courtyard. In the Khamis Mushait Villa design, for example, a curved outdoor stair connects the shaded terrace to the balcony so the family can move between floors from the courtyard. Once the concept feels right, we agree on the scope and fee for the drawings.

Frequently asked questions about private villa design

How do I start designing my villa in Jeddah?

Start with the plot location in the inquiry form or on WhatsApp. For the first call, have the plot size to hand if you know it, along with your priorities for the house. The call and preliminary concept are free. We agree fees once you are happy with the direction.

Can we meet on my plot in Jeddah?

Yes. We can arrange a visit to look at access, views and neighbouring buildings together. Include the district in your inquiry so we can discuss on the first call whether a visit would help at this stage.

Can we work together if I’m outside Jeddah?

Absolutely. We serve clients across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf remotely via video calls and shared drawings, with the same clarity.
